fix(syntax): every option takes effect or is gone (rich-syntax-fh2) (#256)

* fix(syntax): every option takes effect or is gone (rich-syntax-fh2)

- language picks a grammar (javascript, typescript, python, bash, text);
  SyntaxLanguage is the union, so a name with no grammar is a type error.
  One left-to-right scan, so a // in a string or a keyword in a comment
  is not highlighted.
- colours are syntax.* names in the console Theme; the ignored `theme`
  option is removed.
- wordWrap wraps (continuation rows unnumbered) or crops; before, wrapped
  pieces were joined back onto one overflowing line.
- lineRange keeps each line's number from the whole code.
- padding and Syntax.fromPath (always threw) are removed.
- empty lines are kept; measure reads the same shown lines as render.

* fix(syntax): tokenize the whole code, bound every row to the width (rich-syntax-fh2)

Review of #256: a lineRange starting inside a multi-line string tokenized
as code; an unknown runtime language crashed at render; measure spread
every line into Math.max and reported min over max; justify realigned
each line; a gutter wider than the offer overflowed it; property names
like .get/.type drew as keywords.
